name: zinput_bindgroup_list_clear
description: zInput::BindGroupList_Clear destroys every bind group and resets the active vector end pointer to the begin pointer.
known_limits: The smoke verifies direct clear behavior. VC5SP3 zinput_bindmap_context now fails this function with 64 unmasked mismatches after 48 relocation bytes and 10 trimmed VC5 NOPs; the owner still has sibling byte blockers.
